newsitem.title: INDIA: Fiat to make Palio cars in India - paper.
newsitem.headline: Fiat to make Palio cars in India - paper.

text.p: Fiat Auto Spa has sought government approval to set up a joint venture with India's Vinod Doshi family to manufacture Palio brand cars in India, the Times of India newspaper reported on Thursday.
The Vinod Doshi family controls Premier Automobiles Ltd, which manufactures Fiat Uno cars under licence.

Fiat will own 74 percent of the proposed joint venture while the Doshi family will take the remaining stake. A new plant will be built near the western city of Pune with a capacity to manufacture 100,000 Palio cars a year, it said.
Production is expected to begin in mid-1999, it said quoting unnamed company sources.
A lump sum fee of $10 million would be paid by the joint venture to Fiat Auto. In addition it would be paying a royalty of five percent on domestic and export production, it said.
The Doshi family or officials of Premier Automobiles were not immediately available for comment.
